notes.title: Halloween "bewitched" content update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37899091/b010f547428bec17edadfa1f92ca5d1e1cc32b2a.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

we have a big content update for you today. ːsteamhappyː
So, let's head straight into the changes.

[h3][b]NEW LEVEL 05[/b][/h3]

[img]https://media2.giphy.com/media/318IOhfELWNKW3bJ9T/giphy.gif?cid=790b761178ec90752791df75f091240b6e6e5702b352e638&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g[/img]

The biggest change is our new spooky swamp level. The treats at the house may look tasty but beware the murky waters. If you stay in there too long, one of the tentacles may grab and pull you down.

[h3][b]NEW CHARACTER[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37899091/d70407ce5db1fbc74f4571f4c60ee494a7e159d6.jpg[/img]

Behold the mighty dragon! Look at this fearful creature with his little piggy. The newest member of our failed fairy character cast. Come on, give him a hug and show him that the world ain't that scary!

[h3][b]READABILITY UPDATE[/b][/h3]

The readability of the game is always a big challenge. So with each patch we try to improve on this aspect. In this update we give you 2 major improvements.

[h3][img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/XkJxvNH143K9yDsbBi/giphy.gif?cid=790b761185658092854d92d37caec81be974832a0408f634&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g[/img][/h3]

First, we added depth blur to the levels to make the play area pop out more and easier to read. This should help you get a better overview of all the chaos.
Second, we have the input prompts in the forest. You should now see input prompts for "Jump" and "Wall jump" when you approach the tree or the wall. This should help a new player get into the game.

[h3][b]NEW LEVEL SELECTION[/b][/h3]

[img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/oxHKWkOdo2RyzUdwkt/giphy.gif?cid=790b76116fb23cfb9204c80ef0c6e4c88befbd5ef4311257&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g[/img]

We also reworked our level selection to make it a bit easier to understand. That means it's now  compatible with the ONLINE multiplayer. No random levels anymore for the ONLINE mode.

[b]Small changes:[/b]
Each phase now has a Timer.
9000 bug fixes
9000 asset fixes
9000 small improvements.

notes.title: v. 1.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Our next patch brings a bunch of [b]visibility changes, online stability and UX improvements[/b]

1.0.2 Public Patch Notes:
- Fixed simultaneous scrolling in name input screen
- Temporarily removed bubble trap to fix design issues
- Adjusted camera speed
- Version Check for Online Games
- Display Version Number in Settings
- Fixed crash when joining midgame
- Fixed bug where input was not possible on gamestart

- Improved Lighting in Cliffs
- Improved visibility of Dolly
- Improved visibility of the Cauldron projectile
- Improved visibility of the FrostWand projectile
- Improved trampoline extra height on certain jumps, now happening less often

- Updated Credits
- Changed SceneLoader Sorting

- Added defaultName property to settings.json file, can be manually set to override random default names (this is a temporary workaround and might not work for everyone)

Carry on fairyfailing and let us know what you think about thos changes :)
